text: The location of an existing school bus loading zone (SBLZ) on Heather Road requires a slight relocation to accommodate a new school driveway at 51 Heather Road, in front of St. Bartholomew Catholic School. We now need to formalize the relocation of the SBZL in the traffic by-law and permanent signs will be installed. The current by-law states the SBLZ is in effect on the south side of Heather Road, between a point 105 metres west of Brimley Road and a point 38 metres further west. The by-law should be amended to be in effect on the south side of Heather Road, between a point 127 metres west of Brimley Road and a point 36 metres further west.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Amended the existing school bus loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on the south side of Heather Road, between a point 105 metres west of Brimley Road and a point 38 metres further west, to be in effect between a point 127 metres west of Brimley Road and a point 36 metres further west.
